note: Reel 36: Find Him (working title). Draft 3, after two cold reads. The narrator is the series voice (af_heart, speed 1.0). Lines that need a real pause are their own lines. Facts: docs/research.md. n07 ('picked goes') is voiced beside n07c ('chose goes'): reel 35's 'picked the' lost its t in every take, and here a lost t would turn the guilt line back into the ritual line ('Whoever you pick goes to jail'). Read the phonemes and the transcriptions before placing either.
ref_text: The night was cold and very quiet. Most of the street was asleep, and the lamps hummed over the empty road. Somewhere far away, a train rolled past, and then the silence came back.

lines.text: You've got two seconds to learn his face.
This time, he's in the line.
Whoever you pick goes to jail.
Unless you saw the mole, you were looking for the cap.
Whoever you picked goes to jail.
Whoever you chose goes to jail.
You'd know a friend in any cap.
On a stranger, the cap is half of him.
So try it on someone who's never seen him.
